LanguageData.BS_TeamSubtitleImpostor: Eliminate the crew without being caught
LanguageData.BS_CallMeetingDesc: Calls the whole crew to the cafeteria for a vote.
LanguageData.BS_MeetingCooldown: The button is not ready yet.
LanguageData.BS_CamerasDesc: Shows each room and the colonists inside.
LanguageData.BS_ShipMapDesc: Shows the ship map, with the number of colonists in each room.
LanguageData.BS_SabotageText: Sabotage! Repair the stations in: {0}. About {1} seconds left.
LanguageData.BS_KillDesc: Kills the nearest crewmate within reach. Do it when nobody sees you.
LanguageData.BS_KillNotReady: Your blade is not ready yet.
LanguageData.BS_SabotageDesc: Starts a sabotage that the crew must repair.
LanguageData.BS_TrackDesc: Follows one colonist for a day.
LanguageData.BS_NecroHears: You hear the body of {0} in {1}.
LanguageData.BS_ShapeshiftDesc: Takes the suit colour of another colonist for a day.
LanguageData.BS_VanishDesc: For a short time, your kills are not witnessed.
LanguageData.BS_VotePrompt: Who is the impostor? Vote, or skip.
LanguageData.BS_VoteSpectator: You can only watch the vote.
LanguageData.BS_WinOutnumbered: The impostors are as many as the crew.
LanguageData.BS_WinSabotage: The sabotage was not repaired in time.
LanguageData.BS_SabotageDoorsText: Every door is locked for a short while. The emergency button is off and bodies cannot be reported.
LanguageData.BS_KillBlocked: A guardian shielded the target: the kill failed.
LanguageData.BS_EvidenceReady: The crew has enough evidence against {0}. {0} can be eliminated.
LanguageData.BS_EjectEvidence: {0} was eliminated based on the evidence.
LanguageData.BS_BecameGuardianGhost: You are a guardian ghost now. You can do tasks and shield one colonist from the next kill.
LanguageData.BS_BecameTaskGhost: You are a ghost now. You can only do tasks.
LanguageData.BS_Protecting: You shield {0} from the next kill.
LanguageData.BS_ProtectDesc: Shields one colonist from the next kill.
LanguageData.BS_AccuseDesc: Eliminates an impostor against whom the crew has enough evidence, without a vote.
LanguageData.BS_GhostCannot: A ghost can only do tasks.
